usage: The word '鹽焗雞' is used as a noun to refer to a specific chicken dish cooked by salt-baking.
'鹽焗雞' can appear as the subject or object in a sentence, for example, '我想食鹽焗雞' (I want to eat salt-baked chicken).
When talking about restaurant menus, '鹽焗雞' usually stands alone without modification or plural forms.
You can use '鹽焗雞' with quantities or measures, such as '一隻鹽焗雞' (one salt-baked chicken).
It is common to describe the dish with adjectives before '鹽焗雞', like '好味嘅鹽焗雞' (delicious salt-baked chicken).
